options: A method of encrypting files so they cannot be read without a key
A method of decreasing the size of files or data to save storage space and communication bandwidth
A method of duplicating files across several servers
A method of converting text files into images
A method of deleting old files automatically
questions.explanation: Data compression reduces the size of files or data by encoding information using fewer bits than the original representation, saving storage space and bandwidth.

questions.stem: Why is data compression described as especially significant in the age of Big Data?
options: Because compressed data cannot be hacked
Because Big Data is always structured and easy to store
Because unstructured data has a substantial influence on cloud storage costs, and neglecting compression means unnecessary expenditure and longer return-on-investment timelines
Because compression eliminates the need for cloud storage entirely
Because Big Data regulations require all files to be compressed
questions.explanation: In the Big Data era, unstructured data drives cloud storage costs; failing to use compression translates into unnecessary spending and extended ROI timelines.

questions.stem: In text compression, how might the sentence 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog' be made smaller?
options: By storing each character in 16 bits instead of 8
By translating the sentence into another language
By deleting every second word
By replacing commonly used words or phrases with shorter codes that are expanded again on decompression
By converting the text into an image
questions.explanation: Text compression replaces frequently used words or phrases with shorter codes; when decompressed, the original sentence is reconstructed exactly.

questions.stem: Which image compression format is named as achieving significant file size reduction while maintaining reasonable image quality?
options: JPEG
MP3
ZIP
ASCII
RGB
questions.explanation: JPEG is the common image compression format cited for reducing file size substantially while keeping reasonable image quality.

questions.stem: How do audio compression algorithms such as MP3 reduce file size?
options: By increasing the sampling rate of the recording
By removing redundant or less perceptually important information, exploiting the fact that our ears are less sensitive to certain frequencies
By storing each note as a text description
By duplicating the audio track for redundancy
By converting stereo sound into video
questions.explanation: MP3 and similar algorithms discard data that listeners are unlikely to notice, taking advantage of the ear's reduced sensitivity to certain frequencies.

questions.stem: What distinguishes lossless compression from lossy compression?
options: Lossless compression always produces smaller files than lossy compression
Lossless compression is used only for audio; lossy only for text
Lossless compression retains all the original data when decompressed, while lossy compression sacrifices some information for higher compression ratios
Lossy compression retains all data; lossless discards some
There is no difference; the terms are interchangeable
questions.explanation: Lossless compression returns exactly what you started with, like zipping and unzipping a file. Lossy compression trades some detail for a much smaller file, as JPEG does.

questions.stem: Zipping a file and then unzipping it returns exactly the same file. Which kind of compression does this illustrate?
options: Lossy compression
Audio compression
Perceptual compression
Image compression
Lossless compression
questions.explanation: Getting back exactly what you started with after decompression is the defining feature of lossless compression, illustrated by the zip/unzip example.

questions.stem: In JPEG compression, some details in an image may be lost. What is the trade-off for this loss?
options: A much smaller file size
Higher image resolution
Better colour accuracy
Faster camera shutter speed
Automatic backup of the original
questions.explanation: JPEG is lossy: some image detail is sacrificed, and the trade-off is a much smaller file size.

questions.stem: How do streaming services make use of data compression?
options: To store user passwords more securely
To transmit audio and video efficiently so users can watch or listen without downloading huge files
To increase the number of adverts shown
To convert video into text subtitles
To prevent users from pausing playback
questions.explanation: Streaming services use compression to transmit audio and video efficiently, letting users watch videos or listen to music without downloading enormous files.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT an example of data compression in use?
options: Downloading a ZIP file and unzipping it to restore the original files
Using JPEG to store a digital photograph
Using MP3 to store a music track
Storing each ASCII character of a text file at its full 8 bits without any encoding
A streaming service transmitting a film efficiently
questions.explanation: Storing each character at its full 8-bit ASCII representation is the uncompressed original; ZIP, JPEG, MP3 and streaming transmission are all forms of compression.
